values.brief: Three webinars for clinic managers on running bookings from one inbox. **Goal:** 120 sign-ups and 30 qualified leads by the end of November.

link.title: Five ways clinics lose booking requests

values.title: Five ways clinics lose booking requests
values.notes: For clinic managers who run bookings from a shared inbox. It leads into the webinar sign-up.

values.top-performer: The webinar email to past trial users: a third of this week’s sign-ups came from it.
values.next-week-focus: Test a shorter subject line on the second webinar email.

values.what-worked: Inviting past trial users. They signed up more and stayed for the whole session more often than anyone else.
values.what-wed-change: Record the first webinar and share it sooner. The replay brought in almost as many leads as the live sessions.
